content: We regard the retrieved facts from the external KB as neighbors to the arguments to be enhanced. Inspired by BIBREF22 scarselli2009graph, we update the vector of an element $v_e$ as follows, where $(e)$ and $(e)$ represent adjacent arguments from the facts retrieved by object and subject, respectively. In this work, $f(\cdot )$ is implemented by averaging the vectors of two arguments.
